about:
Specfab Services was founded in 1986 in Greenville, South Carolina. The company operates an 80,000-square-foot manufacturing facility where skilled craftspeople combine traditional metalworking with computer-driven equipment to produce precision metal products and custom equipment for industrial and commercial clients.

The shop offers a full spectrum of metal fabrication services, including laser cutting (6,000 W fiber and 4,000 W CO2 systems with automation), MIG/TIG and robotic welding, punching with load/unload automation, forming, rolling, grinding, polishing, hardware insertion, and complete machine assembly. Engineering support uses SOLIDWORKS 3D modeling linked directly to production equipment, and a coordinate measuring machine validates first articles through a PPAP process.

Specfab serves customers in pharmaceutical, chemical, and food processing and packaging facilities worldwide, as well as broader industrial and commercial sectors. The company handles projects ranging from single custom fabrications to high-volume production runs.

The company’s stated mission is to deliver a quality product solution at a fair price, emphasizing service and delivery as constant priorities. Its ISO 9001:2015 certification and in-house CMM inspection with PPAP first-article validation underscore a focus on documented quality control.
